source: Live captures of codex-cli 0.165.0 and Claude Code 2.1.312 (macOS, tmux), 2026-10-29: the startup folder-trust prompt of each, nothing answered and nothing saved to the trust config. Codex run directly in tmux (w80, w120, w200) and through hoptell tmux (option 2 is Quit there, Back to Agent Command Center otherwise). Rows: capture-pane -p; cursor: cursor_x, cursor_y; size: the pane size. Temporary paths are replaced with same-length placeholders.
